label: Fixed-universe research · observed 2019–2025 prices
universe_note: Twenty currently identifiable US stocks selected for sector variety, not on backtest results. This is not point-in-time index membership and has survivorship/selection bias. Random draws answer a fixed-universe question only.
replacement_note: Different-issuer common-stock proxies, selected before running results. They maintain invested exposure, not identical factor exposure. No claim of employer or legal approval. Corporate reorganization relationships and household activity require review.
tax_payment_rule: first_session_on_or_after_february_1_following_tax_year; final outstanding taxes settled at horizon
cost_note: All costs, rates, borrow availability and maintenance requirements are educational assumptions, not historical quotes or client terms.
